item.title: [Fri, Oct 16] Up-off Gymnastics, Dance, and Spanish
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Lone Cone Library Norwood We are a MOBILE family business offering non-competitive Gymnastics, Preschool Spanish, & Dance classes to the San Miguel County area. Tia Uphoff was a competitive gymnast and an instructor for 20+ years, helping children develop balance, flexibility, strength and proper tumbling techniques while using positive reinforcement and encouragement for success. Infant to Age 5 — Padres & Pequenos Class – $10.00 per class This class invites adults & kids to participate in Educational songs, in English & Spanish, with intro to gymnastics. Sign up at any time and get started weekly. Fridays — 11:15-11:40 am @ Lone Cone Library Norwood K to 3rd Grade week Session 8 Week Winter Session $150 for the 8 sessions. Thursdays – 430-530 pm @ Lone Cone Library Norwood For more information and to register: Contact Tia @ liv2danz247@gmail.com or find us on Facebook!

item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Planning and Zoning Commission Meeting — 2026-10-19
item.description:
Town of Norwood • 2026-10-19
Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission meets October 19 at 6:30 p.m. at Town Hall. Two substantive items anchor the session: a Land Use Code Update and a Master Plan Update — both the kind of foundational work that shapes what gets built where, and under what rules, for years to come. The board will also address a Board Seat Update. Consent agenda covers September 21 minutes.
⚡ Why it matters: Norwood reviews Land Use Code and Master Plan updates — rules shaping future development.

item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Historic & Architectural Review Commission - Oct 21 2026 — 2026-10-21
item.description:
Town of Telluride • 2026-10-21
The October 21 HARC meeting is anchored by the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment Project — the Town of Telluride's own large-scale development at 860 Black Bear Rd, zoned Accommodations 2. HARC takes up Buildings 1 and 2 as one public hearing item and Buildings 3 and 4 as a second, both continued from August 19. Each application covers new construction outside the Telluride Historic Landmark District exceeding 5,000 square feet of floor area under LUC 7-203.B.2.a.1. Also on the agenda: a payment-in-lieu of parking request for one space at 510 W Columbia Ave/129 N Townsend in the Historic Residential zone, where HARC is asked to support administrative approval. A small-scale new construction application at 785 Primrose Lane on a steep site is also up for review. The 448 Tomboy Road item has been continued to December 16 at the applicant's request, and the 214 S Fir Certificate of Appropriateness Amendment #2 — in the works since at least December 2025 — is being tabled for eight more months.
⚡ Why it matters: Public hearings on four buildings in the Town's own large Shandoka redevelopment project.
